candidates_verbatim.body: Ruby amended the new closing routine with a mascot clause: no one locks up until the door is checked, all people are accounted for, and the mascot is confirmed outside the bakery.
candidates_verbatim.narrative_gravity_note: Establishes a standing, slightly comic operational rule that can be tested once a mascot exists.

candidates_verbatim.body: Ruby still wants Fox & Flour to have a welcoming bakery mascot for the neighborhood.
candidates_verbatim.narrative_gravity_note: Keeps the mascot idea alive as an unresolved future addition to the bakery.

candidates_verbatim.body: Tyson proposed installing a tiny bell to warn anyone reaching for the door without thinking.
candidates_verbatim.narrative_gravity_note: Provides a practical-but-comic invention that could reappear as a running gag or actually be installed later.
